datasets.name: CoCoRaHS - Community Collaborative Rain, Hail and Snow Network
datasets.spatial_coverage: United States (primary); expanding to Canada and Caribbean
datasets.notes: ~25,000 citizen-science volunteers; hyperlocal precipitation; hail size verification

datasets.name: Livneh gridded meteorology: North America
datasets.update_status: Static research dataset; not operationally extended.
datasets.spatial_coverage: Contiguous United States (CONUS) with portions of Canada/Mexico depending release
datasets.temporal_frequency: Daily / sub-daily forcing fields depending release

datasets.name: nClimGrid-Daily
datasets.precipitation_basis: GHCN-D gauge interpolation with climate-monitoring QC
datasets.update_status: Operational; updated daily.
datasets.notes: 5 km gridded; derived from GHCN-D; NCA5 reference dataset

datasets.name: nClimGrid-Monthly
datasets.update_status: Operational NOAA climate-monitoring product.

datasets.name: PRISM
datasets.data_archive: PRISM Climate Group, Oregon State University
datasets.update_status: Operational; grids remodeled repeatedly during rolling 6-month window; stable after ~6 months.
datasets.notes: 4 km CONUS; terrain-adjusted; widely used in US ecology and agriculture

datasets.name: USCRN: United States Climate Reference Network (Version 2)
datasets.update_status: Operational; continuously updated.
datasets.spatial_coverage: Contiguous United States (CONUS), Alaska, and Hawaii; also some U.S. territories
datasets.temporal_frequency: 5-minute and hourly; daily and monthly aggregates also available
datasets.curator: NOAA USCRN Program Team. Stations managed by NOAA Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division (ATDD); data maintained and distributed by NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI).
datasets.notes: NOAA-operated network of high-quality climate monitoring stations providing long-term, quality-controlled precipitation and other meteorological observations across the United States. Also distributed through the USCRN public FTP archive and NOAA data distribution services.

datasets.name: CMAP: CPC Merged Analysis of Precipitation
datasets.notes: Merged satellite + gauge precipitation; ENSO/monsoon diagnostics

datasets.name: WorldClim Global Climatologies + Bioclim Layers
datasets.notes: High-resolution global climatologies + CMIP6 scenario layers

datasets.name: CPC Unified Gauge-Based Daily Precipitation
datasets.update_status: Operational; updated daily (source may contain occasional missing dates).
datasets.notes: Gauge-based daily global land precipitation; widely used for validation

datasets.name: DWD/GPCC First Guess Daily
datasets.update_status: Operational high-timeliness product; available ~5 days after observation month.

datasets.name: DWD/GPCC Precipitation Analysis Monthly v2025
datasets.update_status: Ongoing current monthly analysis; GPCC also provides First Guess and Monitoring streams for timeliness.

datasets.name: GHCN-D: Global Historical Climatology Network Daily
datasets.update_status: Operational

datasets.update_status: Operational high-timeliness monthly stream; NOAA PSL distributes the GPCC product.

datasets.name: GPCC Full Data Daily v2022
datasets.update_status: Static/reprocessed release; not extended in real time.

datasets.name: GPCC Full Data Monthly

datasets.update_status: Static/reprocessed Full Data release on NOAA PSL; DWD/GPCC is the originating center.
datasets.notes: >75K rain gauges; 0.25°-2.5° grid; standard precipitation climatology

datasets.name: GPCC Monitoring Product

datasets.update_status: Operational GPCC monitoring stream; NOAA PSL distributes a mirror. Current PSL holdings checked through Jun 2026.

datasets.name: PREC/L: Precipitation Reconstruction over Land
datasets.update_status: Listed by NOAA PSL as continuing to present; monthly climate product.

datasets.name: TerraClimate
datasets.notes: Water balance variables; drought and ecosystem applications

datasets.name: University of Delaware Terrestrial Precipitation
datasets.update_status: Legacy/static; no longer updated at NOAA PSL.

datasets.name: Daymet: Daily Surface Weather Data on a 1-km Grid for North America, Version 4 R1
datasets.period_of_record: 1980-most recent full year (continental N. America/Hawaii); Puerto Rico from 1950
datasets.update_status: Operational annual extension; each year processed after calendar-year close.
datasets.spatial_coverage: Canada, USA, Mexico; separate Hawaii and Puerto Rico
datasets.notes: 1 km N. America; widely used in ecological and hydrological modeling

datasets.name: MSWEP v3: Multi-Source Weighted-Ensemble Precipitation
datasets.precipitation_basis: Machine-learning blend of satellite, reanalysis, gauges
datasets.update_status: Near-real-time; v3 described in 2026 with ~2 h latency. Product continues to evolve.

datasets.name: PREC: Precipitation Reconstruction
datasets.update_status: Listed by NOAA PSL as continuing to present.

datasets.name: CERA-20C: Coupled reanalysis of the 20th Century
datasets.precipitation_basis: 10-member coupled Earth-system reanalysis; precipitation generated by coupled model atmosphere
datasets.update_status: Static historical product; legacy public access route decommissioned.

datasets.name: CFSR / CFSv2: Climate Forecast System Reanalysis
datasets.precipitation_basis: Coupled atmosphere-ocean-land-sea-ice reanalysis/analysis; precipitation from model physics
datasets.update_status: CFSR fixed for Jan 1979-Mar 2011; operational CFSv2 analyses continue afterward. Treat the 2011 system transition as a potential inhomogeneity.
datasets.resolution: CFSR commonly 0.5°; native atmospheric T382 products also archived
datasets.temporal_frequency: Hourly time-series products; 6-hourly analysis cycles; monthly means

datasets.name: ERA-20C: ECMWF's atmospheric reanalysis of the 20th century
datasets.precipitation_basis: ECMWF 20th-century atmospheric reanalysis assimilating surface pressure and marine winds; precipitation model-generated
datasets.update_status: Static historical product; ECMWF legacy public service decommissioned.

datasets.name: ERA-Interim
datasets.precipitation_basis: ECMWF 4D-Var atmospheric reanalysis; precipitation from short forecasts/model physics
datasets.update_status: Legacy. Production ended Aug 2019; users directed to ERA5.
datasets.temporal_frequency: 6-hourly analyses; forecast precipitation at sub-daily accumulation steps; monthly

datasets.name: ERA5: fifth generation ECMWF reanalysis for the global climate and weather
datasets.precipitation_basis: ECMWF atmospheric reanalysis; total precipitation is forecast/model-generated, constrained indirectly by assimilated observations
datasets.update_status: Operational. ERA5T updated daily at ~5-day latency; final release ~2-3 months later.

datasets.name: JRA-3Q: Japanese Reanalysis for Three Quarters of a Century
datasets.precipitation_basis: JMA 4D-Var reanalysis; precipitation is primarily model forecast/diagnostic output
datasets.update_status: Operational near-real-time continuation; NCAR holdings extended through Jul 2026 when checked.
datasets.resolution: Native TL479 ~40 km; also distributed on 1.25° lat/lon grid
datasets.temporal_frequency: 6-hourly core fields; some diagnostics 3-hourly or hourly; daily/monthly statistics

datasets.name: JRA-55: Japanese 55-year Reanalysis
datasets.precipitation_basis: JMA reanalysis; precipitation from forecast/model physics
datasets.update_status: Near-real-time updating terminated at end of Jan 2024; superseded by JRA-3Q.
datasets.resolution: ~55 km model resolution; common distributed grids ~1.25°

datasets.name: MERRA-2: Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, version 2
datasets.precipitation_basis: NASA GEOS atmospheric reanalysis; model precipitation diagnostics; bias-corrected precipitation forcing also provided for land applications
datasets.update_status: Operational; approximately 3 weeks after end of observation month.

datasets.name: NCEP/DOE Reanalysis 2
datasets.precipitation_basis: Updated NCEP reanalysis with corrected assimilation/model errors; precipitation is model-generated
datasets.update_status: NOAA PSL monthly continuation; archive reached Feb 2026 when checked.

datasets.name: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1
datasets.precipitation_basis: NCEP/NCAR assimilation system; precipitation is model-generated forecast output
datasets.update_status: NOAA PSL archive reached Mar 17, 2026; PSL notice indicates routine updates ended in Mar 2026.

datasets.name: NOAA/CIRES/DOE 20th Century Reanalysis (V3)
datasets.precipitation_basis: Ensemble reanalysis assimilating mainly surface pressure; precipitation generated by model
datasets.update_status: Static completed historical reanalysis.
datasets.resolution: ~75 km native; 1.0° gridded products at NOAA PSL

datasets.name: ERA5-Land
datasets.precipitation_basis: Offline land replay forced by ERA5; precipitation forcing/model land product; observations influence it indirectly through ERA5
datasets.update_status: Operational; extended forward at ~5-day latency in current CDS time-series products.

datasets.name: NARR: North American Regional Reanalysis
datasets.precipitation_basis: Regional Eta/RDAS reanalysis; unusually, precipitation observations are assimilated, improving hydroclimate fields
datasets.update_status: Operational archive; NOAA PSL updated monthly; data reached Jun/Jul 2026 when checked.
datasets.spatial_coverage: North America / adjacent oceans on Lambert conformal domain

datasets.name: GPCP Daily v3.3: Global Precipitation Climatology Project
datasets.precipitation_basis: Satellite + gauges; constrained to GPCP monthly
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; updated monthly.

datasets.name: GPCP Monthly v3.3: Global Precipitation Climatology Project
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; monthly. Recent files may be ICDR/preliminary before final CDR status (~1 yr transition noted by NCEI).
datasets.notes: Global satellite + gauge CDR; Global Precipitation Climatology Project

datasets.name: CHIRPS v3: Climate Hazards Center Infrared Precipitation with Stations
datasets.update_status: Operational. Preliminary ~2 days after each pentad; final monthly, typically third week of following month.
datasets.notes: blended satellite + gauge; drought early warning focus

access_endpoints.name: UCSB Climate Hazards Center (CHC) data repository

datasets.name: CMORPH CDR v1.0: CPC MORPHing technique
datasets.precipitation_basis: Passive microwave propagated by IR motion; gauge bias correction
datasets.update_status: Ongoing; CDR-quality archive typically ~2-4 months behind real time; preliminary stream also available.
datasets.spatial_coverage: Quasi-global; nominal global analysis, satellite belt

datasets.name: GSMaP v8: Global Satellite Mapping of Precipitation
datasets.update_status: Operational; near-real-time and gauge-calibrated streams; historical reanalysis maintained.

datasets.name: IMERG Final Run v07: Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM
datasets.update_status: Operational; Final Run delayed by roughly months; Early/Late streams available at much shorter latency.
datasets.spatial_coverage: Global / near-global satellite precipitation; V07 products distributed on global grid
datasets.notes: 0.1° / 30-min global; extends TRMM record; flash flood EWS

datasets.name: PDIR-Now: PERSIANN Dynamic Infrared-Rain Rate
datasets.precipitation_basis: Dynamic IR rain-rate retrieval calibrated with precipitation climatology/microwave information
datasets.formal_cdr: No — not a formal NOAA CDR
datasets.update_status: Operational near-real-time; peer-reviewed documentation gives ~15-60 min latency.

datasets.name: PERSIANN Hourly
datasets.precipitation_basis: Neural-network satellite retrieval; geostationary IR with microwave-based adjustment
datasets.formal_cdr: No — not a formal NOAA CDR
datasets.update_status: Operational/near-real-time family product; historically ~2-day latency; available through CHRS Data Portal.

datasets.name: PERSIANN-CCS
datasets.formal_cdr: No — not a formal NOAA CDR
datasets.update_status: Still distributed by CHRS, but superseded by PDIR-Now as the principal near-real-time PERSIANN product.
datasets.temporal_frequency: Hourly distributed; higher-frequency retrieval basis; daily/monthly aggregations

datasets.name: PERSIANN-CCS-CDR v2.0
datasets.precipitation_basis: High-resolution historical IR climate record; GridSat-B1 and CPC-4km subproducts
datasets.formal_cdr: No formal NOAA CDR designation; research climate-data-record product
datasets.update_status: Latest version added to CHRS Data Portal in Aug 2025; v2.0 documented in Scientific Data (2026).

datasets.name: PERSIANN-CDR v1r1 Daily
datasets.update_status: Operational climate record; final archive is delayed relative to real time. NCEI identifies the product as 1983-present.
datasets.temporal_frequency: Daily (monthly/yearly aggregations also distributed by CHRS)
datasets.notes: Long satellite-based daily precipitation CDR; gauge-sparse regions

datasets.name: TRMM/GPM V07B
datasets.update_status: Legacy (TRMM); Operational (GPM)
